description: Add a transition (Fade, Cross Fade, Fade With Black or Fade With White) where two adjacent clips meet in the video timeline (Timeline panel transitions)

frames.description: Frames on top of the seconds, at the timeline's frame rate

target.description: The two adjacent clips (layers) to join

names.description: Layer names (every layer with each name)

type.description: fade, cross_fade, fade_black or fade_white. Default cross_fade

name: add_video_transition
title: Add Video Transition
